summary: Allows the oya verify CI mirror integration tests to execute inside a parent oya verify run by clearing the inherited parent recursion guard only in the test fixture command environment.
claim_boundary: This change updates test-fixture environment handling and evidence/task tracking. It claims the D-4 nextest recursive oya verify blocker is resolved locally. It does not claim the production recursion guard was weakened, full oya verify is green, remote CI is green, or remaining D-5/D-6 governance lanes are fixed.

facets.F1_simplicity: One fixture command-builder now removes only OYA_VERIFY_RUNNING before intentionally spawning the real oya binary; production verify.rs child-command propagation is unchanged.
facets.F2_correctness: The CI mirror tests now model their nested verifier invocation even when the parent cargo/nextest process inherited the production recursion guard from an outer verify run.
facets.F3_architecture: Keeps recursion prevention in production code and localizes the exception to tests that deliberately validate the mirror contract with fake cargo/oya/git commands.
facets.F5_quality: Focused integration tests and workspace nextest pass under OYA_VERIFY_RUNNING=1, matching the previous failure environment.
facets.F10_ci_cd: Moves local full verify D-4 from failing on six recursive oya verify tests to passing; full verify remains non-green on recorded D-5/D-6 governance lanes.
facets.F13_reversibility: The fixture-only env removal can be reverted independently of production verification behavior.
